loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The LLM operates as an asynchronous black-box meta-optimizer and is invoked only when P-Control shows signs of sluggishness.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The loop it Oin −−→i′ t Pθ −→at Oout −−→a′ t executes at two time scales
planning_granularity.note: No plan object or planning instruction described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: multiple agents (tenants) negotiate towards an SLA consensus guided by a network mediator (MNO)
multi_agent_topology.note: Type II negotiation is peer-with-mediator; Type I is a single agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each agent merges the human operator intent (from tenants or MNO), the messages of other agents, and the negotiation chat history to a unified intent

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the human operators (tenants) express their intents to their dedicated controller
human_in_loop.note: Humans set intents that gate negotiation; no per-action approval described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the last ten⟨Kp,ι⟩ pairs stored in a small short-term memory

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The short-term memory collects knowledge from past actions with the LLM self-improving in an agentic manner
long_term_memory.note: Memory is within-run only; vector DB proposed as future work.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Logs L and KPIs provide lifecycle logging
state_persistence.note: Logging only; no resume path described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: novel NLG evaluation approaches use LLM-based annotators for large-scale automated testing
self_verification.note: LLM judge is used for offline evaluation, not in the run loop.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If it is larger than a threshold, here two iterations, the LLM updates the Kp value exploring a better configuration
retry_policy.note: LLM is re-invoked until KPI ι ≤ 2; negotiation repeats until consensus.

rollback.evidence_quote: compliance monitoring of the KPIs and observance of deviations could trigger rollback
rollback.note: Rollback only stated as a possibility ('could trigger'), not implemented.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the system satisfies max i|x(k) i − ¯x(k)| < ϵ, we declare consensus convergence
termination_condition.note: Negotiation ends on convergence within 2-5 rounds; control loop ends when ι ≤ τ.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: A quantized llama-3-3b achieves tuned-P accuracy while fitting in 2 GB of GPU VRAM
cost_controls.note: Model-size choice reduces cost but no budget/caching/routing mechanism in the harness.

timeouts.evidence_quote: This keeps total wall-clock time within the 10 − 48 secs non-RT envelope, dominated by LLM latency rather than negotiation logic
timeouts.note: Latency budgets are described but no enforced timeout.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It is built using OpenAirInterface (OAI) [47] for the 5G Core, RAN and UEs, FlexRIC [48] for the RIC, and custom implementations for the rest of the components.
execution_isolation.note: Agent actions are API calls into RAN controllers; no sandbox described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: The new Kp gain is streamed back to the P-Control, while P-Control keeps running
network_policy.note: No network restriction described; agents call cloud APIs and RIC.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Numeric guard-rails and KPI triggers prevent adversarial or hallucinated ac- tions from propagating to the real-time loop.
permission_model.note: Numeric bounds (confidence interval, clamp to [0,100]) act as the action allowlist.

tracing.evidence_quote: all traces logged by logs L for audit

replayability.evidence_quote: L logs the internal trace for audit and feeds compliance signals back to Pθ.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Any numeric bid must lie inside [L,U ]; otherwise the message must include a clear justification.
guardrails.note: Input-side optimizer bounds the prompt; numeric guard-rails constrain actions.
